title: add downgrade guard, schema migrations, and safe rollback tooling for private installer
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: customers running Private (VPC / on-prem) deployments need safe upgrade/rollback guarantees. We observed two post-upgrade incidents where schema drift and unpinned component versions prevented automated rollback and required manual db restores. This PR adds a downgrade guard, explicit version pinning for installer components, automated pre-upgrade backups, and reversible schema migration patterns so rollbacks can be performed with confidence.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds a downgrade guard to the private-installer that prevents downgrades across incompatible schema versions unless an explicit --force-downgrade flag is used and a validated snapshot is present.
- Introduces version pinning for core installer artifacts: k8s manifests, helm chart references, and the terraform module manifest to ensure deterministic upgrades/rollbacks.
- Adds a backup-and-restore workflow: pre-upgrade snapshot step (etcd/postgres depending on topology), verification hooks, and a restore path invoked by the rollback command.
- Implements reversible DB migrations: split migration/validation pattern (prepare + apply) and an accompanying undo migration script for critical schema changes.
- Updates the Helm chart (templates and values) to include upgrade-time hooks for backups and to expose a safe rollback annotation.
- Adds e2e smoke tests that run a dry-run upgrade, backup verification, and simulated rollback in a local KinD environment.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc referenced in Linear ENG-7623
- [x] Backup/restore scripts covered by unit tests and e2e smoke
- [x] Migration scripts include forward and undo paths
- [x] Helm hooks added and documented
- [x] Terraform module version pin implemented
- [x] CI passes on rerun (had a transient e2e failure on first run)

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps the default behavior conservative: downgrades are blocked by default to avoid accidental data loss. Operators can opt into force downgrades but must supply a validated snapshot file. The implementation aims to be backward-compatible with existing installer configs; in a follow-up we will add a CLI telemetry metric to track rollback usage (ENG-7701).
commits_summary: 6 commits: initial downgrade-guard framework; add migration prepare/undo scaffolding; helm chart hooks and annotation; terraform module pinning + docs; backup/restore scripts and unit tests; e2e smoke tests and CI fixes.
review_summary: Rajat left the initial review noting a couple of edge cases around partial migration failures and suggested adding explicit transaction boundaries to the prepare step; Nora requested clearer logging for restore failures and an operator-facing troubleshooting doc; Diego requested a stronger assertion that the snapshot matches the cluster topology before allowing force-downgrade. Author replies: added transactional prepare/commit pattern for Postgres, implemented topology validation check, and expanded docs with a troubleshooting section and clear CLI exit codes. Final reviewers approved after CI rerun.
ci_checks_summary: CI run history: first run failed on tests/e2e due to flakiness in KinD networking; tests re-run after flakiness fix -> all checks passed. Checks: unit (pass), integration (pass), e2e-private (pass on re-run), lint (pass), helm-int (pass), terraform-validate (pass).
release_notes: Adds safe upgrade/rollback tooling for Private installer: downgrade guard (blocks unintended downgrades), pre-upgrade backup and restore workflow, reversible DB migration scaffolding, helm hooks for safe upgrades, and terraform version pinning. Operators must run the pre-upgrade snapshot step; downgrades require explicit --force-downgrade and a validated snapshot. See docs/private-installer/upgrade-rollback.md for full runbook.
